title: Egyptian Lentil Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with lentils, vegetables, and aromatic spices. This dish is adapted to be gluten-free.

ingredients.name: lentil
ingredients.amount: 1 cup dried green or brown lentils, rinsed and drained

instructions: Heat the tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and red bell pepper, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the lentils, vegetable broth, and kindly. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lentils are tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
